zh.svnOfferExpired: 网络访问提案已过期；请手动重试，并重新勾选同意。
zh.svnExpired: SVN 网络授权已过期，历史请求已停止；请重新审阅并同意。
zh.svnConsentReview: 审阅 SVN 网络访问范围
zh.svnConsentScope: 同意前仅读取本地身份。授权只适用于所列仓库、Session 与目录，五分钟有效；不授权重定向或写操作。
zh.svnConsentExplicit: 我同意访问以上 HTTPS SVN 仓库
zh.svnHistoryScope: 固定本地 revision 快照的 SVN 历史；分页替换显示
zh.svnCopyOutside: 复制来源在授权范围外，不能打开
zh.svnCopyTraceScope: 单独查看范围内固定来源，仍止于其复制边界；不是自动追溯
zh.svnTraceScope: 文件追溯在复制边界停止，不跟随范围外来源
zh.svnGrantScope: 网络授权五分钟有效；可随时撤销，历史操作不修改工作副本。
zh.svnRevoke: 撤销 SVN 网络授权
zh.svnIdentity: 查看 SVN 本地历史访问身份
zh.svnOfflineIdentity: 仅从授权工作副本读取本地元数据，不发起远程请求。
zh.svnRemoteDisabled: 远程 SVN 历史传输尚未启用；没有网络授权或可用访问凭据。本页不是已授权历史入口。
zh.historyWindow: 已加载历史窗口（序号左闭右开）
zh.historyWindowScope: 列表及图最多保留200条；继续加载替换较新行，跨窗口边不表示完整图。局部筛选仅当前窗口。
zh.segmentScope: 仅固定历史 UTF-8 普通文件，最大 16 MiB；每片最多 64 KiB，替换显示不累积。片段行号不是原文件行号，不是全文件 Diff。
zh.fileHistoryMergeBoundary: 身份边界：合并提交，此处停止，不推断多父来源
zh.fileHistoryAmbiguous: 多个候选来源，此处停止追溯
zh.fileHistoryRenameLimit: 已达32次重命名确认上限，此处停止
zh.fileHistoryBoundary: 身份边界：复制或非精确重命名，此处停止
zh.fileHistoryFollowScope: 跟随Git检出的重命名；50%以上相似重命名额外确认唯一删除／新增来源，歧义、复制和合并处停止。相似度不是身份保证；每条记录使用当时路径。
zh.graphLaneLimit: 泳道最多32条；超出部分省略图形，完整已加载节点与关系仍可在文字中查看。
zh.historyBranchScope: 引用由下方手动加载；选择后固定该次OID，刷新引用不会移动历史起点。选择HEAD重新读取当前HEAD，不切换工作区。
zh.historyServerScope: 查询固定快照可达的完整历史；说明/作者为忽略大小写的字面匹配，路径为精确路径或目录，不追踪重命名。分页与运行时间有界。
zh.title: VCS 变更
zh.noSession: 先打开一个项目会话，再查看变更。
zh.noRepo: 未发现 Git / SVN 仓库。可输入相对子目录后重新扫描。
zh.conflictStagesScope: 手动读取所选冲突的 Index 阶段1／2／3；阶段编号只表示 Index 身份，不声称合并／变基归属。缺失阶段显示为空，不推断内容；不读取工作文件，不解决冲突。
zh.conflictStageGitlink: 子模块提交引用，不加载内容
zh.conflictStageMissing: 所选阶段缺失，按空内容比较；不推断原始内容。
zh.binary: 二进制或受限内容无法按文本比较
zh.stale: 内容发生变化，请刷新后重试。
zh.scanHint: 仅扫描当前目录及一级子目录，不递归深入 · 缓存 5 分钟后过期
zh.truncated: 已达到扫描上限。输入相对子目录并重新扫描以补充其他位置。
zh.fallback: 高级编辑器不可用，已切换为基础左右文本对比。
zh.approximate: 内容较大，使用近似行对齐。
zh.commitNoChanges: 相对此基线无文件变更
zh.workspaceLargeScope: Git工作区完整UTF-8比较，每侧8MiB／10万行；读取期间变化会拒绝结果，成功后文件仍可被外部修改。
zh.largeScope: 仅Git历史UTF-8普通文件，每侧最多8MiB、10万行；不是工作区或SVN大文件。
zh.diffPending: 正在计算差异，尚不能判断是否相同。
zh.diffIncomplete: 差异计算未完成或超时，当前结果可能不完整。
zh.largeFallback: 基础视图只展示有界片段，不代表完整大文件差异。
zh.historyListOnly: 本地 HEAD 历史；选择提交及文件查看只读文本差异。
zh.historyRefsScope: 标记来自最近一次手动加载的本地引用，不代表提交创建时的分支状态；刷新失败时保留上次成功结果。
zh.historySearch: 筛选已加载提交（作者 / 摘要 / SHA）
zh.historyNoMatch: 已加载提交中无匹配项；可继续加载更多。
zh.historyLimit: 已达到历史浏览范围上限，仍有更早提交未显示。
zh.autoRefresh: 手动或窗口聚焦时刷新
zh.searchShortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + F 搜索；Esc 清空搜索
zh.fileShortcut: Alt + ← / → 切换上一个或下一个文件
zh.pathCopied: 文件路径已复制到剪贴板。
zh.revisionTitle: 本地版本 A/B 比较
zh.revisionScope: 可选择已加载的提交，或手动加载本地分支与标签；直接比较 A → B，不使用合并基点。
zh.revisionEmpty: 两个版本没有文件变更。
zh.pathHistoryScope: 手动读取所选历史路径在该提交下的文件历史；路径必须存在于该提交。关闭跟随时不跨重命名。
zh.pathHistoryFollowScope: 跟随沿用同一保守规则：第一父链、Git相似度至少50%、每次确认唯一删除／新增来源，歧义、复制或32次确认上限处停止；只适用于提交中的普通文件或链接。
zh.fileHistoryScope: 固定提交快照下的精确路径历史；不追踪重命名前路径，包含同路径删除后重建。点击提交后，仅在相对首个父提交（根提交为空树）的变更中唯一匹配同路径时打开 Diff；否则只显示详情。
zh.blameNavigation: 点击归属提交查看详情，并尝试选中该提交变更中路径完全一致的唯一文件（不会猜测重命名或旧路径）；无唯一匹配时不预选文件。默认使用首个父提交，不自动定位行号。
zh.blameScope: 所选提交的 UTF-8 普通文本，最多显示前 500 行；不包含工作区修改。
zh.blameLimit: 仅显示前 500 行，结果已截断。
zh.historicalTreeScope: 所选提交的目录条目；每页 100 项。点击普通文件只读预览；不跟随符号链接或子模块。
zh.treeEmpty: 空文件或无可显示的文本。
zh.graphScope: 仅展示已加载历史的前 200 个提交，最多 1000 条父子边；不受文本筛选影响，不代表完整分支图。节点点击可查看详情。
zh.graphLimit: 图已达到节点或边上限，部分关系未展示。
zh.graphInvalid: 当前提交顺序无法绘图；请使用历史列表。
zh.imageMetadata: 预览已移除附加元数据。
zh.imageScope: 支持非交错静态 PNG 与 8 位单扫描 baseline JPEG 普通文件，以及单块静态VP8／无损VP8L WebP（不支持渐进式/CMYK JPEG、扩展/动画 WebP）；每侧最多 2 MiB、1600 万像素。元数据被移除，不适用于色彩精确性审阅。支持历史提交、固定 A/B 及 Git 工作区；按所选模式读取 HEAD、暂存区或工作文件。冲突图片不支持。
zh.commitMessageLimit: 完整提交说明超过 2 MiB 预览上限，已省略。
zh.revisionLoadRefs: 加载 / 刷新本地分支与标签
zh.revisionRefsScope: 本地分支、指向提交的标签及本地缓存的远程跟踪引用，共最多1000条；不连接远端或fetch，远程缓存可能过期。重新加载时，origin/HEAD 显示它当前指向的本地提交；已选历史和版本仍固定。选择固定为加载时的提交 OID；刷新引用不会移动已选版本。
zh.revisionRefsEmpty: 没有可用的本地分支或提交标签。

en.svnOfferExpired: Network access offer expired. Retry manually and check consent again.
en.svnExpired: SVN network consent expired; history requests stopped. Review and consent again.
en.svnConsentScope: Before consent, read local identity only. Access binds this repository, Session and cwd for five minutes; redirects and writes are not authorized.
en.svnConsentExplicit: I consent to access the HTTPS SVN repository above
en.svnHistoryScope: SVN history at a fixed local revision snapshot; pages replace displayed rows
en.svnCopyOutside: Copy source is outside the authorized scope
en.svnCopyTraceScope: Separate fixed in-scope source history, stopping at its copy boundary; not automatic tracing
en.svnTraceScope: File trace stops at copy boundaries and does not follow out-of-scope sources
en.svnGrantScope: Network consent lasts five minutes; revoke at any time. History operations do not modify the working copy.
en.svnOfflineIdentity: Read local metadata from the authorized working copy only; no remote request.
en.svnRemoteDisabled: Remote SVN history transport is not enabled; no network grant or usable access token. This is not an authorized history entry point.
en.historyWindow: Loaded history window (start inclusive, end exclusive)
en.historyWindowScope: List and graph retain at most 200 rows; more loads replace newer rows. Boundary edges are not a complete graph. Local filtering covers this window only.
en.segmentScope: Committed UTF-8 regular files up to 16 MiB; replaceable 64 KiB segments. Segment line numbers are not original file lines; this is not a full-file Diff.
en.blameUnmapped: Origin line cannot be located precisely
en.fileHistoryMergeBoundary: Identity boundary: merge commit; stopped without inferring parent origin
en.fileHistoryAmbiguous: Multiple candidate origins; tracing stopped here
en.fileHistoryRenameLimit: 32 rename confirmations reached; tracing stopped here
en.fileHistoryBoundary: Identity boundary: copy or inexact rename; stopped here
en.fileHistoryFollowScope: Git-detected renames; similarities of 50% or more require a unique deletion/addition transition. Stops at ambiguity, copies and merges. Similarity is not an identity guarantee; rows use historical paths.
en.graphLaneLimit: At most 32 lanes. Overflow geometry is omitted; loaded nodes and relations remain available as text.
en.historyBranchScope: Load references manually below. Selection pins that OID; refreshing references does not move the history tip. Selecting HEAD reads current HEAD without checking out.
en.historyServerScope: Search all history reachable from the pinned snapshot. Message/author use case-insensitive literal matching; path is an exact path or directory, without rename following. Pagination and runtime are bounded.
en.title: VCS changes
en.noSession: Open a project session to inspect its changes.
en.noRepo: No Git / SVN repositories discovered. Try a relative subdirectory and rescan.
en.conflictStagesScope: Manually reads Index stages 1/2/3 of the selected conflict. Stage numbers are Index identities, not merge/rebase ownership claims. Missing stages show as empty and are never inferred; the working file is not read and the conflict is not resolved.
en.conflictStageGitlink: submodule commit reference, contents not loaded
en.conflictStageMissing: A selected stage is absent, so it is compared as empty; original content is not inferred.
en.binary: Binary or restricted content cannot be compared as text
en.stale: Content changed. Refresh and try again.
en.scanHint: Scan current directory and immediate children only · cache expires after 5 minutes
en.truncated: Discovery limit reached. Enter a relative subdirectory and rescan to include another location.
en.fallback: Advanced editor unavailable. Showing basic side-by-side text comparison.
en.textTruncated: Only the first 2000 lines are displayed.
en.commitNoChanges: No file changes against this baseline
en.workspaceLargeScope: Complete Git working-copy UTF-8 comparison: 8 MiB / 100000 lines per side. Changes during loading reject the result; external edits remain possible afterward.
en.largeScope: Git historical UTF-8 regular files only: 8 MiB and 100000 lines per side, not working-copy or SVN large files.
en.diffPending: Computing differences; equality is not yet known.
en.diffIncomplete: Difference computation is incomplete or timed out; displayed results may be partial.
en.largeFallback: The basic view shows bounded excerpts, not the complete large-file diff.
en.historyListOnly: Local HEAD history. Select a commit and file to view a read-only text diff.
en.historyRefsScope: Labels reflect the last manually loaded local refs, not branches at commit creation. Failed refreshes retain the last successful result.
en.historyNoMatch: No matches in loaded commits; you can load more if available.
en.historyLimit: History browsing limit reached; older commits are not shown.
en.autoRefresh: Refresh manually or on window focus
en.searchShortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + F to search; Esc clears search
en.fileShortcut: Alt + ← / → switches the previous or next file
en.pathCopied: File path copied to the clipboard.
en.copyFailed: Unable to copy the file path.
en.revisionScope: Choose loaded commits or manually load local branches and tags. Compare A → B directly, not via merge-base.
en.revisionEmpty: No file changes between these revisions.
en.pathHistoryScope: Manually reads the file history of the selected historical path at that commit; the path must exist in that commit. Without following, renames are not crossed.
en.pathHistoryFollowScope: Following uses the same conservative rules: first parent, Git similarity of at least 50%, a unique deletion/addition confirmed each time, stopping at ambiguity, copies or the 32-confirmation cap; only committed regular files or links are supported.
en.fileHistoryScope: Exact-path history at the pinned commit; no rename following, including deletion and recreation. Selecting a commit opens its Diff only for a unique same-path change against the first parent (empty tree for a root); otherwise only details are shown.
en.blameNavigation: Select an attributed commit to view details and preselect the single exactly matching path in that commit; rename or old paths are never guessed, and a missing or ambiguous match preselects nothing. The first parent is used and no line is auto-located.
en.blameScope: UTF-8 regular text at the selected commit, first 500 lines at most. Working changes are excluded.
en.blameLimit: Only the first 500 lines are shown; result truncated.
en.historicalTreeScope: Entries at the selected commit; 100 per page. Select regular files for read-only preview; symlinks and submodules are not followed.
en.treeEmpty: Empty file or no displayable text.
en.graphScope: First 200 loaded commits, at most 1000 parent edges. Independent of text filtering; not a complete branch graph. Select a node for details.
en.graphLimit: Node or edge limit reached; some relationships are omitted.
en.graphInvalid: Cannot graph this commit order; use the history list.
en.imageMetadata: Ancillary metadata was removed from this preview.
en.imageScope: Non-interlaced static PNG or 8-bit single-scan baseline JPEG regular files , or single-chunk static VP8 / lossless VP8L WebP (no progressive/CMYK JPEG or extended/animated WebP); at most 2 MiB and 16 million pixels per side. Metadata is removed; not suitable for color-critical review. Supports commits, fixed A/B and Git working changes; HEAD, index or working bytes follow the selected mode. Conflicted images are unsupported.
en.commitMessageLimit: Full commit message exceeds the 2 MiB preview limit and was omitted.
en.revisionLoadRefs: Load / refresh local branches and tags
en.revisionRefsScope: Local branches, commit tags and locally cached remote-tracking refs, at most 1000 total; no network or fetch. Remote caches may be stale. Reloading origin/HEAD shows its current local target; selected history and versions stay pinned. Selections pin the loaded commit OID; refreshing refs does not move selected versions.
en.revisionRefsEmpty: No local branches or commit tags are available.
